spell.name: Fireball

components.m: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

entries: A bright streak explodes in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Fire damage on a failed save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3.

spell.name: Shield

time.condition: which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} spell

entries: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you.
